observation: The dataset contains two temporal anomalies: November 2016 has 0 orders (operational collection pause between pilot and full release). September-October 2018 is heavily right-censored: only 20 orders total (1 in Sep, 4 in Oct, none delivered) because data extraction stopped at August 31, 2018.

author: E-Commerce Brasil / ABREV
observation: In Brazilian e-commerce, fulfillment is postal/courier; there is no PVZ try-on buyout concept ('выкуп'). Return rates in Brazil average 12-20% under CDC Art. 49, but the Olist dataset contains zero return events, zero reverse logistics tables, zero cart events, zero stock/inventory tracking, and zero commission rates.
application: Revenue = sum(price) for status 'delivered' is an analytical convention defined by the hackathon rubric, NOT proof of accounting net revenue or customer retention after returns. The model must not hallucinate a conversion funnel from nonexistent cart/return events.
limitations: Cannot calculate true merchant payout, marketplace take-rate, or post-delivery return rate from provided 8 CSVs.
implementation: Explicitly distinguish metric names: item_revenue (sum(price) where delivered), order_gmv (sum(price+freight) where delivered), and document lack of returns data in design memo.
license: Public Domain / Editorial

author: Data Engineering Practice
observation: Orders have 1:N relationship with order_items (112,650 rows across 98,666 orders) and 1:M relationship with order_payments (103,886 rows across 99,440 orders). An unaggregated join orders JOIN order_items JOIN order_payments creates a Cartesian product (fan-out) that multiplies line item prices by payment rows and multiplies payment values by item rows.
application: The core schema must either maintain distinct fact tables for each grain (fact_order_item, fact_order_payment, fact_order) or pre-aggregate measures to the order grain before joining.
limitations: A wide single table model (OBT) is fundamentally invalid without pre-aggregated surrogate columns.
implementation: Design Kimball star/constellation schema with separate facts: fact_order_item (grain: order_id, order_item_id), fact_order_payment (grain: order_id, payment_sequential), and fact_order (grain: order_id).
license: Open Access

author: Olist Data Team
observation: review_id is not globally unique (99,224 rows in raw.order_reviews): 789 review_ids map to multiple order_ids, and 547 orders have more than one review. Survey systems triggered identical review_ids for simultaneous multi-order purchases. Naive deduplication on review_id silently drops feedback for ~800 orders.
application: The natural primary key of raw.order_reviews is composite (review_id, order_id). Modeling as a single fact_order_review preserves 100% of rows without payload loss. Normalizing into dim_review + bridge requires verifying that review payload is strictly identical across orders.
limitations: Reviews with the same review_id share identical score and comments across linked orders.
implementation: Define primary key on (review_id, order_id). In data quality ledger, verify count(*) = 99,224 rows preserved.
license: MIT

author: Olist Data Team
observation: There are 99,441 customer_id entries mapping to 96,096 customer_unique_id entities. 250 buyers have orders delivered to multiple ZIP code prefixes. Asserting that these 250 buyers 'moved' (переехали) is an unverified narrative assumption. Buyers frequently ship to offices, relatives, or holiday addresses.
application: The delivery address is an immutable attribute of the order (where was it sent?), NOT a mutable attribute of the customer entity. Putting address in dim_customer or inventing SCD2 for moving causes historical corruption and unnecessary complexity.
limitations: Customer entity table only stores the snapshot address from customer_id records; there is no customer change-log table.
implementation: Model customer_unique_id as natural key of dim_customer (96,096 rows). Keep order shipping location (zip_code_prefix, city, state) on the order fact.
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

author: Analytics Community
observation: In 366 orders, order item total sum(price + freight) differs from sum(payment_value), resulting in a net discrepancy of -1,819.51 BRL. Discrepancies stem from platform vouchers covering partial totals, cent-level rounding during multi-item freight division, and unfulfilled line items where payments were adjusted.
application: The model must NOT silently overwrite or force-balance price or payment_value. Both distinct measures must be preserved in their respective fact tables, with a dedicated reconciliation/audit query or mart table exposing the discrepancy delta.
limitations: Individual voucher discount line items are not available as distinct ledger rows; only voucher payment_value is given.
implementation: Define order reconciliation query: round(sum(p.payment_value)::numeric, 2) - round(sum(i.price + i.freight_value)::numeric, 2). Save discrepancies in a quality mart/ledger.
license: Open Access

Предположение из profiling.md о 'переезде' является непроверенной гипотезой. В e-commerce разные адреса означают доставку на работу, подарок родственникам, дачу или опечатки в CEP. В таблице нет таймстампов смены адреса или подтверждения резиденции.

author: ClickHouse Inc / MotherDuck Engineering
observation: PostgreSQL 16 использует строковое хранилище (heap pages) и построчный итератор без векторных SIMD-инструкций, что вызывает вымывание shared_buffers при широких аналитических сканах. При объеме Olist (550k строк, ~100MB) PG16 работает идеально в памяти. Эмпирические триггеры перехода на специализированный OLAP: размер таблиц фактов >50-100GB, P95 латентности дашбордов >3-5с, деградация OLTP-транзакций из-за аналитических блокировок и потребность в 5-10x сжатии данных.
application: Обоснование стратегии развития: 1 этап (текущий, <5M строк) — PostgreSQL 16 с партиционированием по месяцам и BRIN; 2 этап (5-50M строк) — PG реплика + dbt/DuckDB; 3 этап (>50M строк) — CDC в ClickHouse (клиентские витрины) и Snowflake/Lakehouse (корпоративный DWH).
limitations: ClickHouse требует изменения парадигмы моделирования (дерево MergeTree, денормализация, отказ от частых multi-way JOIN).
license: Apache 2.0

limitations: Незначительное дублирование текста комментария для ~800 связок (~0.8% объема).
implementation: CREATE TABLE core.fact_order_review (order_id text, review_id text, review_score int, PRIMARY KEY (review_id, order_id))
